The language guard now follows the same task budget into group orchestration and visible summaries.

## What changed since 0.4.50

- The AI output-language guard is applied through a single provider decoration bound to a per-task budget. Group orchestration and visible summary generation enter the same budget as the main chat; internal classification, embedding and other non-delivery calls pass through untouched.

- Carries all 0.4.50 features: reply-enhancement horse-head entry (font color off / bottom-up theme ripple generating / solid theme ready, same with evolution on or off), idle-hiding chat scrollbar, at-most-two silent language corrections, background memory (progressive recall, recall traces, virtual directory, derived project overview, confirmed same-source correction tombstones), stable immutable project IDs with host-determined scope, and the Pondsi Attribution License.

## Honest boundaries

- Language detection is heuristic; short or uncertain text is left alone. Enabling the guard adds local checks and up to two extra model calls per task; it does not guarantee compliance and latency differs from the off state.

- Derived memory is not the original record; corrections require evidence and never rewrite chat originals. Model output and generated files still need review. Permissions remain per session; no self-improvement can disable the safety boundaries.

## Install

Download WArmy-Setup-0.4.51.exe from this release and run it. Existing WArmyData carries over. The installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation. The installer SHA-256 is listed in the Checksum section below. First run stops at the language page and waits for you.
